about: Opt-in lookahead for default-command flag prefixes. Parent flags before the first default-only flag retain their bindings; the implicit boundary otherwise has normal subcommand scope.

vectors.doc: Default-only bundled flags select the default before binding.
vectors.spec:
name "em"
bin "em"
unknown_flags "error"
default_subcommand "install"
default_subcommand_flags #true
flag "-p --pretend"
flag "-c --config <path>"
flag "-v --verbose" global=#true
cmd "install" {
 alias "i"
 flag "-u --update"
 flag "-a --ask"
 flag "-r --remove"
 flag "--output <path>"
 arg "[package]"
}
cmd "query" { alias "q"; }
cmd "search" {}
